def parse(data):
    if len(data) < 11 or data[:5] != b'\x95\x19\xdb\x98\x68':
        return None
    if data[5:8] != b'\x00\x00\x00':
        return None
    count = data[8]
    if count > 8:
        return None
    source = int.from_bytes(data[9:11], 'big')
    i = 11
    recs = []
    for _ in range(count):
        vals = []
        for _ in range(4):
            if i >= len(data):
                return None
            ln = data[i]; i += 1
            if i + ln > len(data):
                return None
            t = data[i:i+ln]; i += ln
            if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7e for c in t):
                return None
            vals.append(t.decode('ascii'))
        if i + 2 > len(data):
            return None
        zone = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+2], 'little'); i += 2
        recs.append({'created_at': vals[0], 'sequence': vals[1],
                     'stock': vals[2], 'label': vals[3], 'zone': zone})
    if i != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': {'source': source}, 'records': recs}

_HDR = b'\x58\xbd\x8d\x1a\xab\x00\x00\x00'


def _str(data, pos):
    if pos >= len(data):
        return None
    n = data[pos]
    pos += 1
    if pos + n > len(data):
        return None
    s = data[pos:pos + n]
    if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
        return None
    return s.decode('ascii'), pos + n


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 9 or data[:8] != _HDR:
        return None
    count = data[8]
    r = _str(data, 9)
    if r is None:
        return None
    account_id, pos = r
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        r = _str(data, pos)
        if r is None:
            return None
        price, pos = r
        r = _str(data, pos)
        if r is None:
            return None
        prio, pos = r
        records.append({'price_cents': price, 'priority': prio})
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': {'account_id': account_id}, 'records': records}

_HDR = b'\x56\xd5\x19\xc6\xe0\x00'


def _str(data, pos):
    if pos >= len(data):
        return None
    n = data[pos]
    pos += 1
    if pos + n > len(data):
        return None
    s = data[pos:pos + n]
    if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
        return None
    return s.decode('ascii'), pos + n


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 7 or data[:6] != _HDR:
        return None
    count = data[6]
    r = _str(data, 7)
    if r is None:
        return None
    ts, pos = r
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        r = _str(data, pos)
        if r is None:
            return None
        rts, pos = r
        if pos + 2 > len(data):
            return None
        records.append({'count': int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos + 2], 'little'),
                        'timestamp': rts})
        pos += 2
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': {'timestamp': ts}, 'records': records}
EOF

def parse(data: bytes):
    data = bytes(data)
    end = len(data) - 4
    if end < 15 or data[:4] != b'\x66\xcb\x2f\xf0' or data[4] != 0x49 or data[5] != 0:
        return None
    if int.from_bytes(data[end:], 'little') != (sum(data[:end]) & 0xFFFFFFFF):
        return None
    count = data[6]
    pos = 7
    n = data[pos]; pos += 1
    if pos + n + 1 > end:
        return None
    s = data[pos:pos+n]; pos += n
    if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7e for c in s):
        return None
    category = s.decode('ascii')
    source = data[pos]; pos += 1
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= end:
            return None
        n = data[pos]; pos += 1
        if pos + n + 5 > end:
            return None
        ts = data[pos:pos+n]; pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7e for c in ts):
            return None
        label = int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos+2], 'little')
        account_id = int.from_bytes(data[pos+2:pos+4], 'big')
        name = data[pos+4]
        pos += 5
        records.append({'account_id': account_id, 'label': label,
                        'name': name, 'timestamp': ts.decode('ascii')})
    if pos != end:
        return None
    return {'header': {'category': category, 'source': source}, 'records': records}

def parse(data: bytes):
    data = bytes(data)
    end = len(data) - 4
    if end < 12 or data[:4] != b'\xa4\x37\x3f\xbd' or data[4] != 0xf2 or data[6:9] != b'\x00\x00\x00':
        return None
    if int.from_bytes(data[end:], 'little') != (sum(data[:end]) & 0xFFFFFFFF):
        return None
    count = data[5]
    id_ = data[9]
    cnt = int.from_bytes(data[10:12], 'little')
    pos = 12
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= end:
            return None
        n = data[pos]; pos += 1
        if pos + n + 7 > end:
            return None
        amt = data[pos:pos+n]; pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7e for c in amt):
            return None
        ca = int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos+4], 'little')
        ow = data[pos+4]
        ts = int.from_bytes(data[pos+5:pos+7], 'big')
        pos += 7
        n = data[pos]; pos += 1
        if pos + n > end:
            return None
        src = data[pos:pos+n]; pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7e for c in src):
            return None
        records.append({'amount': amt.decode('ascii'), 'created_at': ca,
                        'owner': ow, 'source': src.decode('ascii'),

    if pos != end:
        return None

PREFIX = b'\xea\x03\x85\x26\xee'


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 13 or data[:5] != PREFIX or data[6:9] != b'\x00\x00\x00':
        return None
    count = data[5]
    header = {'enabled': int.from_bytes(data[9:13], 'little')}
    pos = 13
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        n = data[pos]
        pos += 1
        if n < 1 or pos + n + 4 > len(data):
            return None
        s = data[pos:pos + n]
        pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
            return None
        records.append({'amount': s.decode('ascii'), 'count': int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos + 4], 'little')})
        pos += 4
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}
EOF

PREFIX = b'\x62\x89\x45\x4f\xd7\x00'


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 15 or data[:6] != PREFIX:
        return None
    count = data[6]
    header = {
        'checksum': int.from_bytes(data[7:9], 'big'),
        'created_at': int.from_bytes(data[9:11], 'little'),
        'id': int.from_bytes(data[11:15], 'big'),
    }
    pos = 15
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        n = data[pos]
        pos += 1
        if n < 1 or pos + n + 12 > len(data):
            return None
        s = data[pos:pos + n]
        pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
            return None
        records.append({
            'count': int.from_bytes(data[pos + 4:pos + 8], 'little'),
            'label': int.from_bytes(data[pos + 8:pos + 12], 'little'),
            'rating': int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos + 4], 'little'),
            'sku': s.decode('ascii'),
        })
        pos += 12
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}
EOF

PREFIX = b'\x11\x60\xfe\xa4\x78\x00\x00\x00'


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 17 or data[:8] != PREFIX:
        return None
    count = data[8]
    header = {
        'enabled': int.from_bytes(data[13:17], 'little'),
        'name': int.from_bytes(data[9:13], 'little'),
    }
    pos = 17

    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        n = data[pos]
        pos += 1
        if pos + n + 5 > len(data):
            return None
        s = data[pos:pos + n]
        pos += n
        if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
            return None
        records.append({
            'count': data[pos],
            'item_count': int.from_bytes(data[pos + 1:pos + 5], 'little'),
            'score': s.decode('ascii'),
        })
        pos += 5
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}
EOF

PREFIX = b'\x5b\xb8\xeb\x5b\x58'


def _str(data, pos, allow_empty):
    n = data[pos]
    pos += 1
    if (not allow_empty and n < 1) or pos + n > len(data):
        return None, pos
    s = data[pos:pos + n]
    pos += n
    if any(c < 0x20 or c > 0x7E for c in s):
        return None, pos
    return s.decode('ascii'), pos


def parse(data: bytes):
    if len(data) < 11 or data[:5] != PREFIX or data[6:9] != b'\x00\x00\x00':
        return None
    count = data[5]
    header = {'created_at': int.from_bytes(data[9:11], 'little')}
    pos = 11
    records = []
    for _ in range(count):
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        s1, pos = _str(data, pos, False)
        if s1 is None or pos + 6 > len(data):
            return None
        checksum = int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos + 2], 'big')
        timestamp = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 2:pos + 4], 'big')
        flags = int.from_bytes(data[pos + 4:pos + 6], 'little')
        pos += 6
        if pos >= len(data):
            return None
        s2, pos = _str(data, pos, True)
        if s2 is None:
            return None
        records.append({'checksum': checksum, 'created_at': s1, 'flags': flags, 'owner': s2, 'timestamp': timestamp})
    if pos != len(data):
        return None
    return {'header': header, 'records': records}
EOF
